steps: Figures: (5,9,6),(9,6,3),(6,3,2),(3,2,0) as (top-left, centre, bottom-right)
Previous centre becomes top-left, previous bottom-right becomes centre, so next is (2, 0, new)
A and C have 0 top-left and 2 centre - eliminated

Chose D; 1 is the new digit that appears in two options (C and D), 2 would repeat

figs=[(5,9,6),(9,6,3),(6,3,2),(3,2,0)]
for a,b in zip(figs,figs[1:]):
    assert b[0]==a[1] and b[1]==a[2]
opts={'A':(0,2,3),'B':(2,0,2),'C':(0,2,1),'D':(2,0,1)}
last=figs[-1]
ok=[k for k,v in opts.items() if v[0]==last[1] and v[1]==last[2]]
assert ok==['B','D']
# shift rule leaves B and D; D chosen (new corner value 1), rule for the new corner value not determined
chosen='D'
assert chosen in ok

method: Rule tracking: corners rotate clockwise and alternate with middle-row swap
steps: Fig1->Fig2 and Fig3->Fig4: corner symbols rotate one step clockwise, middle row replaced
Fig2->Fig3: middle row F N I O goes to corners TL,BL,BR,TR; corners go to middle in order BL,TL,TR,BR
Apply to Fig4: S,X,triangle,V to TL,BL,BR,TR; middle = I N F O
Only D matches; A, B, C place corners or middle row differently
check_code:
figs=[dict(TL='X',TR='=',BL='tri',BR='up',M=['D','I','N','K']),
      dict(TL='tri',TR='X',BL='up',BR='=',M=['F','N','I','O']),
      dict(TL='F',TR='O',BL='N',BR='I',M=['up','tri','X','=']),
      dict(TL='N',TR='F',BL='I',BR='O',M=['S','X','tri','V'])]
def step_swap(f):  # used for fig2->fig3, fig4->fig5
    m=f['M']
    return dict(TL=m[0],BL=m[1],BR=m[2],TR=m[3],M=[f['BL'],f['TL'],f['TR'],f['BR']])
def rot(f): return dict(TL=f['BL'],TR=f['TL'],BR=f['TR'],BL=f['BR'])
assert step_swap(figs[1])==figs[2]
assert {k:figs[1][k] for k in ('TL','TR','BL','BR')}==rot(figs[0])
assert {k:figs[3][k] for k in ('TL','TR','BL','BR')}==rot(figs[2])
ans=step_swap(figs[3])
opts={'A':dict(TL='S',TR='N',BL='O',BR='I',M=['X','tri','V','F']),
      'B':dict(TL='I',TR='N',BL='O',BR='F',M=['V','S','X','tri']),
      'C':dict(TL='I',TR='O',BL='X',BR='tri',M=['V','N','F','S']),
      'D':dict(TL='S',TR='V',BL='X',BR='tri',M=['I','N','F','O'])}
assert ans==opts['D']
for k in 'ABC': assert ans!=opts[k]
